premises.text: Merchants need identity proof and data protection for digital shoppers
premises.evidence_span: help businesses prove that you are who you say you are and keep your information safe

premises.text: Zero-knowledge-style confirmation that two parties share the same attribute without exchanging it
premises.evidence_span: confirm that the information that they have is the same without ever exchanging the information

premises.text: Identity exchange network makes prior verifications reusable across merchants
premises.evidence_span: access it through an identity exchange

premises.text: Banks, payment companies, sharing-economy platforms, and age checks all need identity assurance
premises.evidence_span: Banks need it to do KYC. Payment companies need to do it to make sure that they get paid and not ripped off

premises.text: Transactional pricing with 30% to information providers
premises.evidence_span: we give 30% of that back to the provider of the information

premises.text: Compete by unifying real-time fraud monitoring and identity verification into one fast accurate flow
premises.evidence_span: We want to bring those two things together and make it fast and accurate

value.text: Prove who someone is and keep data safe without handing over personal information
value.evidence_span: no information left my browser, no information left the server in the bank

causal_links.evidence_span: Identity is enormous. It underlies every commercial transaction
Every verification we do, we charge a fee for

notes: BT UK identity exchange announcement excluded as traction. Fraud/IDV unification kept as product positioning premise tied to the tech domain.
